comments.body: I know it’s 300K extra which is crazy, but MIT is a no brainier it’s literally the STEM university, it’s a stem nerds (like me )wonderland😭 I would 100% choose MIT. However, you should make a list of the pros and cons of each university, visit each one and then make a decision. Follow your heart tho it’s your life. Good luck 🤞
comments.author: OutrageousAd1101
